summary: This bill requires the General Services Administration to collaborate with federal tenants of leased spaces to identify shared-space concerns, develop criteria and special-use strategies to expand sharing, set measurable success objectives, and brief congressional committees within six months.

scores.thoughts: This bill aims to improve the efficiency of federal space utilization through shared-space arrangements, which could lead to cost savings in federal leases. While it doesn't directly appropriate or cut funds, its stated purpose is to optimize resource use, implying a potential reduction in future spending on leased properties.
